---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
shortened_years <- c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020)

hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  drop_na(HR) |>
  summarize(
    total_hr = sum(HR),
    total_g = sum(G),
    hr_per_game = total_hr / total_g,
    .by = yearID
  ) |>
  mutate(
    season_type = if_else(
      yearID %in% shortened_years,
      "Shortened season",
      "Full season"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
hr_by_season |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr_per_game)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(color = season_type, size = season_type)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Full season" = "steelblue", "Shortened season" = "firebrick")
  ) +
  scale_size_manual(
    values = c("Full season" = 1.5, "Shortened season" = 3)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "MLB Home Runs per Game Over Time",
    subtitle = "Shortened seasons blend right into the trend once adjusted for games played",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs per Team-Game",
    color = "Season Length",
    size = "Season Length",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
Teams |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(1981, 1994, 2019, 2020)) |>
  summarize(
    total_hr = sum(HR),
    total_g = sum(G),
    hr_per_game = total_hr / total_g,
    .by = yearID
  ) |>
  arrange(yearID) |>
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 2,
    col.names = c("Season", "Total Home Runs", "Total Team-Games", "HR per Game")
  )
```
